event.odalys_heart2.1.text: Fast. Too fast. ...Breathe with me. In. Out. Nothing in this room needs you frightened.
event.odalys_heart2.1.why: frightened: the joke goes; the doctor gets gentler, which unsettles more

event.odalys_heart2.1.text: Strong, but quick. You've been sleeping badly. Most of the village has, lately.
event.odalys_heart2.1.why: uneasy: she notices the player's nights and the village's

event.odalys_heart2.2.text: Two salads. Eat them sitting down, at a table, in daylight. Indoors by dark on the new moon. Doctor's orders.
event.odalys_heart2.2.why: hint: a custom slipped into the prescription as if it were medicine

event.odalys_heart2.4.text: Half of Wetherell eats standing up. Tonight you eat sitting down, with the lamp lit. I'll check tomorrow.
event.odalys_heart2.4.why: replaces 'You were next', which would read as a threat to a frightened player

event.odalys_heart5.3.text: Edmund's page ends on the fourth night of fall. He chose that. I let him. Some pages I keep closed.
event.odalys_heart5.3.why: revelation (full): Edmund's choice and her part in it, with no ritual imagery

event.odalys_heart5.3.text: Edmund has a page in here too. He followed every instruction, even the last one. I wrote down that he was brave.
event.odalys_heart5.3.why: clue: Edmund chosen, a cost; echoes 'affairs in order' without repeating it

event.odalys_heart5.3.text: Edmund has a page in here too. The last entry is from the fall. I haven't turned to it since.
event.odalys_heart5.3.why: uneasy: a closed page the player can wonder about

event.odalys_heart5.2.text: Use it well. And sleep. What you hear at night is not yours to carry. I carry it.
event.odalys_heart5.2.why: frightened: the leader's protectiveness shows; hurt, not sinister

dlg.story.pie.talk.r2b.text: An empty plate and a crumb on your sleeve. Eating on the road again. Go home; the lamps are lit early.
dlg.story.pie.talk.r2b.why: uneasy: the lamps-lit-early sign, framed as a doctor's nag

event.odalys_heart8.intro.text: Sit. I closed early. You look as though you haven't slept either. Soup first. Questions after, if you must.
event.odalys_heart8.intro.why: frightened: she knows the player has questions and offers soup before them

event.odalys_heart8.intro.text: Sit. I closed early. The nights have been long for everyone. Soup, and company. I've been short of both.

dlg.odalys.office.0.text: I tell everyone to rest. Four nights a year, I keep the whole village asleep instead. Tonight is not one. Be gentle.
dlg.odalys.office.0.why: revelation (full): what she keeps asleep, said as a doctor's joke that is not one

dlg.odalys.office.0.text: I tell everyone to rest. Four nights a year, I can't. This is one of the other nights. Be gentle.
dlg.odalys.office.0.why: clue: a duty on fixed nights, echoing the almanac's four dates

dlg.odalys.office.r2.text: A prescription. For me. 'Come back anyway.' ...I will. Every time. That much I can promise you.
dlg.odalys.office.r2.why: uneasy full: the promise is too exact; she means nights the player does not know about

dlg.odalys.birthday.0.text: You stayed. Most people hurry home this time of year. I have no protocol for this. What now?
dlg.odalys.birthday.0.why: uneasy: the village hurries home; she notices the player did not

dlg.odalys.birthday.r0.text: ...Thank you. You look tired, [player]. Today, let me do the worrying. Consider it my present to myself.
dlg.odalys.birthday.r0.why: frightened: a Keeper's gentleness, turned toward the player

event.overheard_elara_odalys_1.l4.text: No. One cozy per stool. Take the spare home before dark. That is also policy.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_1.l4.why: uneasy: home before dark, slipped in as clinic policy

event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l4.text: ...The best soup all year. Save me a bowl. I'll be out late tonight. Don't wait up.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_2.l4.why: uneasy: a Keeper abroad after dark, overheard

event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l2.text: It's very soft, Elara. ...After the new moon I'll sleep a week. Until then, ten minutes.
event.overheard_elara_odalys_3.l2.why: hint: her sleep is scheduled around the new moon

event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l3.text: Patients keep odd hours. Lately, so does everyone. ...Agreed. Call it a draw.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_1.l3.why: uneasy: the whole village is up at night

event.overheard_odalys_ione_2.l1.text: Ione. I prescribe you a nap. Fifteen minutes. You've been reading by lamplight far too late.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_2.l1.why: uneasy: lamps lit late, a small shared noticing

event.overheard_odalys_ione_3.l3.text: If Hazel reorganized nothing, it's a verified remedy. She's been watching me again. Pass the cup.
event.overheard_odalys_ione_3.l3.why: hint: the Keepers' leader knows the resister watches her; a person to ask

event.overheard_marcus_odalys_1.l3.text: Measure twice, bend the knees once. And nothing alone after dark. That one's mine too.
event.overheard_marcus_odalys_1.l3.why: uneasy: echoes Marcus's own tell back at him, as a doctor

event.overheard_marcus_odalys_2.l2.text: I don't sit on that bench. It faces the wood. I've never had the time.
event.overheard_marcus_odalys_2.l2.why: hint: the real reason, then the cozy excuse as cover

event.overheard_marcus_odalys_3.l3.text: I did say that. You listened. Four nights a year, that matters more than my averages.
event.overheard_marcus_odalys_3.l3.why: clue: the two Keepers' shared duty, overheard between friends

event.odalys_heart8.after.text: {if choice:office.insist}You insisted I rest. I objected for a minute, then slept nine hours. My first full night since fall. Elara is unbearable about it.{else}{if choice:office.soup}We finished the pot. 'Treatment successful. Repeat weekly.' Except four nights a year. Those are already spoken for.{else}Your prescription is pinned above my desk. 'Come back anyway.' On the four nights I can't rest, I read it twice.{/if}{/if}
event.odalys_heart8.after.why: clue: every branch touches her fixed nights of duty

event.odalys_heart8.after.text: {if choice:office.insist}You insisted I rest. I objected for a full minute. Then I slept nine hours, through a night I usually don't. Elara is unbearable about it.{else}{if choice:office.soup}We finished the pot. I've written it up: 'Treatment successful. Repeat weekly. Before dark.' That last part was not a question.{else}Your prescription is pinned above my desk. 'Come back anyway.' I read it on the long nights. I intend to comply.{/if}{/if}
event.odalys_heart8.after.why: uneasy: long nights and before-dark, no clue content

event.odalys_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.odalys.wish}It went in the file labeled 'Unexpected'. That file was empty last winter. Keep yourself well, so it stays full.{else}{if choice:bday.odalys.soup}Shared soup. Elara says I smiled twice. She's wrong. It was three. Now go home before the lamps.{else}I napped twenty minutes. The clinic survived. I didn't dream, for once. Elara says nothing happened. She said it very quickly.{/if}{/if}
event.odalys_birthday.after.why: uneasy: last winter, lamps, dreamless sleep; warmth intact

adds.text: Your great-uncle's pulse was like this. Steady to the end. I checked it every season.
adds.why: clue: she was Edmund's doctor right up to 'the end'; a thing to ask about

adds.text: Don't ask which page. I know a great many things. I choose which to say.
adds.why: her signature tell, covering what she just let slip

cuts.why: the seed-bag joke falls flat in a strained room; the frightened variant of .1 fills the space

notes: heart8 and birthday 'after' lines now have branched variants (round 3b); every cozy branch is kept and reworded.
The heart2 cut removes .3 only at frightened full; .4 (the last line) is varied rather than cut, because 'You were next' reads as a threat to a frightened player.
Revelation lines (heart5.3, office.0) use no ritual words: 'the fourth night of fall' and 'keep the whole village asleep' carry it.
